entries.rationale: empty-tools serialization ported (omit when no active tools and no history; explicit tools:[] once the conversation carries tool history for Anthropic-via-proxy backends); maxTokens clamping and Cloudflare AI Gateway cases pending
prompt-cache breakpoint ordering ported
empty tool result maps to the (no tool output) placeholder on the responses function_call_output; drives production convertMessages via ported convertToolResultOutput
foreign copilot tool-call id normalized to bounded fc_<shortHash> shape on the openai-responses convert path; drives production convertMessages

unique fallback message ids across multiple text blocks in one assistant turn (msg_pi_<n>, then msg_pi_<n>_<k>) verified on production convertMessages; the upstream fixture's thinking->text conversion is pig's separately-ported NormalizeMessages (agent/transform.go), which upstream runs inside convertResponsesMessages

the persisted-block partialJson leak the upstream test guards cannot occur in pig: ToolUseContent has no partialJson field and the streamed argument buffer (cur.argsJSON) is a local strings.Builder never persisted. The observable contract (final tool-call arguments equal the parsed JSON with no duplicate re-emission at function_call_arguments.done) is verified by ai/openai_responses_test.go#TestResponsesSSE_ToolCall, mutation-proven to bite the double-emit path (.done re-emitting full args -> doubled args -> red)

payload-shape contract ported as a unit test driving convertMessages (tool-result images ride inside function_call_output as an input_text/input_image array, no trailing user turn); the live model-behavior assertions across openai/azure/github-copilot/openai-codex stay unported (network + credentials)

error-body passthrough contract verified on the production OpenRouter image provider (non-2xx surfaces the response body reason, never an opaque message). The upstream defect is the openai JS SDK APIError body-blindness; pig reads resp.Body directly on every provider path (completions, responses, openrouter images), so the mechanism is designed out and the behavior is guarded

pipe-separated tool-call-id normalization ported and verified hermetically against upstream goldens (parse call_id|item_id, sanitize, 40-char hash fallback via ported shortHash) plus a production-path call/result consistency test; the four upstream cases are live cross-provider handoffs (github-copilot/openrouter/openai-codex) that require network keys and are not reproduced hermetically
